spec.name: Chibi Axolotl
spec.description: A chibi axolotl with a big round head, three frilly pink gill stalks on each cheek, a wide smiling face, stubby legs and a long finned tail.
spec.layout: The axolotl faces +Z and stands on y = 0. A big chibi head (roughly a third of the whole model, sphere-like with a short blunt snout) fills the front; its top reaches y = 0.48 and its frilly gills fan out to x = ±0.42. Behind it a plump, slightly sagging torso runs from z = +0.16 back to z = -0.20, pale on the belly and warmer pink on top. Four very short stubby legs (front pair near z = +0.12, back pair near z = -0.10) drop from the torso so the belly clears the floor by about 0.10 m and only the tiny round toes touch the ground. The tail continues from the rump at z = -0.16, tapering to a point at z = -0.64, with a tall soft fin crest along the top and a shallower one along the bottom, joined at the tip. The style is chibi everywhere: oversized head and eyes, tiny limbs, bold simple shapes, flat pastel colours, and the signature frilly gills as the loudest feature. The face sits on the front of the head: two big glossy eyes low and wide, a tiny smiling mouth line, small nostril dots, and blush patches under the eyes; nothing covers the face.

parts.builds: The chibi head plus the signature gills. The skull is one big rounded volume (scaled sphere or lofted dome) centred near [0, 0.32, 0.30], about 0.42 wide, 0.36 tall and 0.34 deep, in blushBody, with a slightly warmer blushTop crown cap and a shadeUnder crescent where the head sinks into the neck at the back. The snout is a smaller blunt rounded box or dome at the front around [0, 0.27, 0.40] in blushBody. The face is built as separate parts: two big glossy eyes as flat black eyeInk discs/capsules seated on the surface low and wide at about x = ±0.10, y = 0.30, z = 0.36, each with a small white eyeGlow highlight dot and a thin eyeInk upper lid line; a tiny pink nose (nostril) at [0, 0.30, 0.42]; the mouth as a wide gentle smile of thin mouthLine parts built as two curved arcs plus small end hooks, sitting on the lower snout around y = 0.25, z = 0.41; two round cheekBlush patches under and beside the eyes on the cheek surface. The lower jaw is a small separate dome under the snout around [0, 0.22, 0.36] in blushBody riding the jaw joint so the mouth can open. The frilly gills: three stalks per side, sprouting from the head surface at roughly 30°, 90° and 150° around each side at y = 0.34, each a tapered frustum tube sweeping outward and slightly back, longest at the middle (about 0.16 m), in gillPink with gillDeep near the root; each stalk carries 5–7 small frilly side lobes (tiny flattened teardrops or extruded frills) alternating along it, with a gillTip dot at every stalk tip. All head parts ride the head joint except the jaw dome.
parts.attaches: The head back sinks over the neckBase mount, overlapping the body's front from z = +0.06 to +0.16; the jaw dome pivots at the jaw joint under the snout.

parts.builds: The plump torso. A lofted or swept body from the tailBase mount (z = -0.16, radius about 0.15) forward to the neckBase mount (z = +0.16, radius about 0.17), widest just behind mid at the belly, in blushBody, with the belly underside (the lower third around the front and bottom) in belly and a shadeUnder band at the very bottom where it meets the legs. The back carries a row of 6–8 tiny darker blushTop or shadeUnder freckle dots scattered over the top and sides. A subtle tail-style ridge line of belly colour runs from the chest down to the rump on the underside. Small round shoulder and hip pad bumps on the four leg mounts blend the legs into the body. All geometry rides the body joint except small pieces seated near the neck that also share the neck blend.
parts.attaches: Front edge meets the head at the neckBase mount; rear edge meets the tail at the tailBase mount; four pad bumps seat on the shoulderL/shoulderR/hipL/hipR mounts.

parts.builds: All four stubby legs, identical in construction. Each leg is a short tapered capsule (about 0.11 m long, radius from 0.045 at the hip to 0.035 at the ankle) in blushBody, angled slightly outward, rising from its mount (shoulderL/R, hipL/R at y = 0.24) down to a tiny rounded foot at y = 0.035. Each foot is a small dome in blushBody with three little forward-facing toes (tiny capsules, splayed 20° apart) in toe colour, the middle toe longest, plus two smaller rear toe nubs; the underside of the foot sits exactly on y = 0 with a faint shadeUnder shading at the ankle crease. Each leg rides its own leg joint (legFL, legFR, legHL, legHR). Legs are posed straight down, feet flat, in a readable rest stance.
parts.attaches: Each leg's top sits at its named mount inside the body part's box, sinking into the body's shoulder and hip pads.

parts.builds: The long tapered tail and its fins. A swept tube along the spine chain from the tailBase mount (z = -0.16, radius 0.13) tapering smoothly through tail2 and tail3 to a rounded point at [0, 0.26, -0.64], in blushBody with a belly stripe of belly colour along the underside and a shadeUnder ring at the base where it meets the rump. The signature tail fin: a tall soft dorsal crest running along the top of the tail from z = -0.10 (rising to about 0.09 m above the spine at mid-tail) back to the tip, and a shallower ventral crest (about half the height) along the bottom, both thin fin membranes or extruded blades in tailFin with a tailFinEdge trim line along their rims, the two crests merging smoothly at the tail tip so the tail ends in a rounded fin paddle. 3–4 subtle tailFin crease lines cross each crest. Optional: 4–5 tiny freckle dots (shadeUnder) along the tail's top. All geometry rides the tail1–tail3 chain so the tail bends.
parts.attaches: The tail root continues the body at the tailBase mount, its first 0.04 m buried inside the body's rump.
